about.title: About
about.description: I’m a Senior Flutter developer with a strong product focus. Building commercial apps since 2018 (desktop → mobile since 2022). I take products from 0 to release: architecture (Clean Architecture), state (BLoC), navigation (auto_route), integrations (Firebase/Maps/IAP/Push), CI/CD (GitHub Actions), analytics (Crashlytics/Analytics/AppsFlyer). Founder of the side projects Ovdix and VertoChat.

summary.title: Professional Summary
summary.content: Senior Flutter engineer with a product mindset. I ramp up into codebases fast, establish Clean Architecture, and set up CI/CD and metrics. I ship features in short iterations (tasks ≤ 1 day) and consistently deliver to release. I reduce risk through decomposition, code reviews, and alignment with design/analytics/PM. Strengths: performance (no jank), stability (crash-free), UX polish, and transparent value delivery.

projects.name: Ovdix Platform (iOS/Android)
responsibilities: Designed the app architecture from scratch (Clean Architecture, DI, modularity) → fast releases with no performance regressions.
Implemented auto-translation for listings and chats (GPT-4o-mini) → frictionless multilingual communication without copy-paste.
Set up IAP (client + backend), push notifications, deep links, and sharing → increased engagement and retention.
Established CI/CD (GitHub Actions), signing, profiles, and delivery → predictable release cadence.
Hooked up AppsFlyer/Analytics/Crashlytics and alerts → transparent stability & conversion metrics; fast incident response.

projects.name: ATOM — prototype app for an EV steering wheel (outstaff)
responsibilities: Implemented search to chargers/POI and routing (Yandex MapKit/NavKit) with a traffic gradient overlay → clear road load visualization.
Built complex animations and a custom quick-actions sheet with swipe zones → instant access to key functions without lag.
Joined with zero onboarding and delivered screens for the demo on time → de-risked a key presentation.

projects.name: KDL — medical laboratory
responsibilities: Designed the initial architecture and biometrics-based auth (PIN/Touch ID) → secure and fast re-entry.
Implemented fetching and viewing PDF test results → preserved formatting and correct rendering across devices.

projects.name: App for oil-industry engineers
responsibilities: Refactored legacy to Clean Architecture → reduced coupling, improved testability, and sped up development.
Implemented geolocation with coordinate binding to photo-report metadata → fewer manual reporting errors.
Built a hardened camera module without gallery access → met strict domain security requirements.

projects.name: MusorOFF
responsibilities: Integrated Yandex Maps and lazy screen updates → smooth UX on flaky networks.
Extracted shared modules for courier and client apps → less duplication and faster feature delivery.
Implemented push notification handling → increased app return rate.

projects.name: Vmeste.ru
responsibilities: Complete redesign with custom controls → visual consistency and modern UI.
Added reactions, stories, and welcome stickers in house chats → higher engagement and interaction signals.
Standardized naming and migrated to current .NET/MvvmCross → easier maintenance and onboarding.
Wrote a wrapper over a native Android sticker-carousel library → flexibility and reuse.

projects.name: AKIM — simulation package for physical security systems
responsibilities: Designed a plugin architecture → rapid addition of new modules without rewriting the core.
Built a vector rendering engine for facility layout planning → crisp graphics and artifact-free scaling.
Developed a heuristic path-finding algorithm for agents → realistic simulation without exponential time blow-ups.
Created a low-level C# wrapper around a Delphi simulation engine (AnyDynamic) and 3D visualization with Helix3DToolkit → unified .NET stack for the team.
